messages.subject: Error when choosing colors with scale_color_manual in a plot
parts:
Dear list members,

I am trying to manually select colors for a plot but I get the following error: 

> Leinhardt <- read.table("/Users/manuelspinola/Dropbox/Estadistica_Epidemiologia/Datos_epidemiologia/Leinhardt.csv",header=T,sep=";",quote="")
> Error en scale$palette(n) : 
  el argumento "values" est'a ausente, sin valor por omisi'on
Adem'as: Mensajes de aviso perdidos
Removed 4 rows containing missing values (geom_point). 

It says that the argument "values" is absent.

Any help will be appreciated.

Manuel
